# Shakha 360

> Billing and compliance software for chartered accountancy firms in India that
> have a head office and branches. A firm's data is kept in the firm's own
> Google Drive, not on Shakha 360's servers.

Shakha 360 is used in the browser on a computer or a phone; there is nothing to
install. One head office and any number of branch offices work in one place,
each branch with its own GSTIN, invoice series, clients and staff, while the
head office sees every office.

## What it does

- Billing: GST invoices, proformas, receipts and credit notes for every office, on the firm's own letterhead
- Collections: outstanding fees, ageing and payment reminders
- Compliance: GST, TDS, income-tax and ROC due dates for every client, in one To Do list
- Work allocation: a partner and a staff member for every piece of work, with each person's workload
- Notices and appeals: notices, hearings, orders and appeals, with every date tracked
- Client documents: document requests, client files and client logins
- Certificates and letters: 45 certificate formats, and engagement and appointment letters, with UDIN
- Reports and exports: sales, collections, outstanding, GST and UDIN reports
- Tally Connector: invoices and receipts reach TallyPrime on their own

## Pricing

A single plan for the head office, with add-ons for extra logins, branches and
billing firms, charged yearly and pro-rated for the months left in the year. The
current prices and the free trial length are shown on the pricing section of the
home page, which reads them live from Shakha 360. There is a free trial and no
payment is needed to start.

## Where the data lives

The firm connects its own Google account. Spreadsheets, PDFs and client documents
are created in that firm's Google Drive and stay there. Invoices and reminders go
out from the firm's own Gmail in the firm's name. If a firm stops using Shakha 360,
its files remain in its own Drive.
